text:
Sam W: Heads-up: dashboard shows median for /v1/generate A > /v1/generate B even though raw histograms look opposite. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/snap123.png
Maya R: hmm, is that the rollup view or the raw-sample view?
Sam W: rollup view (combined by endpoint). p50 flips if you include cached responses from edge tier.
Devon K: Is cache-hit tagged? We should exclude cache hits from latency percentiles in the endpoint-level SLO.
Sam W: Cache-hit is tag 'cache:hit' but rollup merges counts and uses tdigest on aggregated summaries -> losing distinction.
Priya N: Are we compressing tdigest between boxes? If so we might be losing low-cardinality weight info.
Jing L: Quick reproduction: query used below. It computes percentiles by merging summaries which is the culprit.
Jing L: ```sql
SELECT merge_tdigest(tdigest) as td
FROM telemetry.rollups
WHERE route='/v1/generate'
  AND window='5m';
SELECT tdigest_percentile(td, 0.5), tdigest_percentile(td, 0.9), tdigest_percentile(td, 0.99);
```
Devon K: So the UX question: should Console's endpoint chart default to 'raw-samples' for p50/p90/p99 or keep 'rollup' but surface a warning?
Sam W: My vote: highlight which aggregation was used and show a toggle. Many users assume p50 == median of raw samples.
Maya R: Also need to show sample count and sample origin (edge/dedicated/cache). Without that, SLO derivation is wrong.
Priya N: We can add a 'sample-origin' legend and a small banner: "rollup percentiles approximate; toggle to raw-samples for exact" :warning:
infra-bot: Note: Rolling up raw tdigest across regions may exceed memory; enabling raw-samples as default could spike storage costs. Deploy note #1187.
Devon K: Ok tradeoff. Proposal: default rollup but show an inline pill 'Rollup (approx)' linking to docs and a one-click 'Compute raw' which runs a heavier query on demand.
Sam W: That sounds reasonable. Also add a tooltip that explains why p50 can move past p90 in merged views (give simple example).
Maya R: UX mock? I'll sketch a pill + tooltip + compute button and post in #design tomorrow.
Devon K: Action: @Jing L to add metrics legend for sample-origin + sample-count. @Priya N to add docs blurb. @Maya R to provide mock. @Sam W to sanity-test with canary route.
Jing L: ack, I'll add the legend and a backend flag to gate heavy queries.
Priya N: ack, I'll write doc blurb and link to the tdigest FAQ.
Sam W: thanks. If anyone has a reproduction snippet that shows p50>p90 send it here.
Maya R: I'll put one up tomorrow.
